title: Web UI lists at scale
statement: The system shall let a user browse, filter, drill down and bulk-edit thousands of requirements in the web UI.
rationale: Reverse-engineered from the implemented reqforge 0.2 behaviour.

acceptance_criteria.text: The first page shows 100 rows and the total
The category tree drills down type → category with breadcrumbs
Columns sort and page size changes
Select-all-matching bulk update applies to every matching record
Facet chips filter with removable pills
Lint and traceability views render, paged and scoped to the tree selection
